# Footnotes and math in Grid tables

+------------------+------------------------------------------+
| Syntax           | Formula or content                       |
+==================+==========================================+
| Inline[^inline]  | $a+b$, \(a-b\), $`xy`$.                  |
+------------------+------------------------------------------+
| Dollar block     | $$                                       |
|                  | \sum_{i=1}^{n} i = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}      |
|                  | $$                                       |
+------------------+------------------------------------------+
| LaTeX block      | \[                                       |
|                  | \int_0^1 x^2\,dx = \frac{1}{3}           |
|                  | \]                                       |
+------------------+------------------------------------------+
| Math fence       | ```math                                  |
|                  | \begin{pmatrix}                          |
|                  | a & b \\ c & d                           |
|                  | \end{pmatrix}                            |
|                  | ```                                      |
+------------------+------------------------------------------+
| Cell footnote    | Reference[^cell].                        |
|                  |                                          |
|                  | [^cell]: Defined inside a cell.          |
+------------------+------------------------------------------+

[^inline]: Defined outside the table, with $x^2+y^2$.
